chapters.hook: The red-herb inventory is short one jar, and the ledger says it was sold somewhere no herb of that grade is sold. Demian finds the entry interesting rather than alarming.
chapters.outcome: The trail ends at a clerk's honest slip, not a theft; the correction goes into both books, and the clerk is praised for the paper trail ♡ - not scolded for the jar. He closes the file: 'Hmm. The arithmetic forgave you before I did.'

chapters.hook: The blue-herb lots carry numbers that stopped parsing mid-season, and the office default is suspicion. Demian starts with questions instead.
chapters.outcome: The grower's signet changed mid-season without filing; the questions find an heir's unregistered mark, which is properly registered ♡, and the market's paperwork quietly improves wherever his review has walked once.

chapters.hook: The yellow-herb depot counts its stock by feel, and the depot master calls the feeling experience. Demian counts it as a habit that has never met a second hand.
chapters.outcome: Two tallies, two hands, one sheet becomes the depot rule. The depot master learns it in an afternoon and teaches it better than the office pamphlet did ♡, which Demian notes with the closest thing he has to a smile.

chapters.hook: The mushroom weight tickets are honest, and every scale around them says they are wrong. Both cannot be true, and Demian wants to hear the scale's side too.
chapters.outcome: The tickets are true and the scale plate is corroded - four grams of rust, exactly. He orders the plate replaced and does not fine the seller whose weights were honest ♡, noting that the scale, like the ledger, is owed maintenance rather than suspicion.

chapters.hook: The clever-mushroom tickets are arithmetically fine and profitably wrong in the second digits. Demian pulls the whole manifest column to be sure.
chapters.outcome: Twos for sevens, everywhere it profits; he cross-checks against the manifest column and initials every margin. The cross-check habit stays ♡, and the swap-artist's route quietly closes under fresh per-ticket numbering without one public word.

chapters.hook: Lively mushrooms weigh one way before they jump and another after, and the depot's flat fee does not believe there is a difference. Demian is writing the schedule.
chapters.outcome: The bounce rule lands: weigh in half-full brackets, exact to the fee schedule. The disputes end ♡, and clerks quote the rule back to him years later believing it older than it is.

chapters.hook: The orchard's receipt book pays 'the crew,' which was six names at harvest and is one name by winter. Demian is going to the orchard in person, with his hat.
chapters.outcome: He verifies payees on site, hat in hand, courteous as arithmetic, and the crew's own tally is honored to the copper ♡. The file closes on a margin he keeps for himself: 'Hmm. Money is not the only thing that was owed here.'

chapters.hook: The harvest ledger's second column is in a different hand than the first - and was written a season later. Demian does not raise his voice; he raises a crosswalk page.
chapters.outcome: He re-links the columns line by line, so the discrepancy can be seen rather than argued. The crosswalk sheet becomes the orchard's standard audit exhibit ♡, quoted at three other farms by autumn.

chapters.hook: The grand audit is days of receipts with one inkwell, which - unlike almost anything else he does - Demian would do for free. The orchard gate will have a rule on it by Friday.
chapters.outcome: He posts it himself: receipts read, totals agreed, then fruit moves. The orchard master copies his phrasing verbatim onto the gate ♡ and, after three attempts, cannot improve it.

chapters.hook: The rainbow-bundle import count skips the festival's dusk arrivals, which is legal and - in Demian's opinion - the most expensive kind of clever. He decides to count them himself.
chapters.outcome: He counts the dusk arrivals at the gate, twice, importer present both times. The loophole closes itself out of embarrassment ♡, which he considers the cheapest regulation ever enforced.

chapters.hook: The blue bundles' shade moves both grade and duty, and the tickets are being politely unhelpful about which is which. Demian requests samples with the paperwork.
chapters.outcome: He samples, initials, and rules the grading fair - then writes the sampling method into the margin for next season. It becomes the office's first margin note ♡, inherited by every auditor since without knowing whose hand it is.

chapters.hook: The wyvern-bundle freight is riding on carts that were hoped at rather than rated, and the load sheets know it. Demian starts at the corners.
chapters.outcome: He checks every axle rating against its load sheet, corner to corner, and the load-sheet rule follows - one cart, one rating, no folklore ♡. Two wagoners still say 'rated, not hoped' as though they thought of it.

chapters.hook: The frost week's permits are arriving early, complete, and paid - which is, for a permit file, the most suspicious thing Demian has seen all season. He has opened the folder.
chapters.text: The frost week's permits are filed correctly by everyone - which is, to Demian, the suspicious part - until he reads the roost's: 'nobody owns wild things,' written plainly in the purposes field, in an almanac hand he half recognizes. He stamps it, waives the fee with a margin line - 'weather, not profit' - and says 'Hmm' in the tone that means approval. That week's paperwork remains his favorite file ♡.
